preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The length of the string s matches the given integer n.

postconditions.description: If no valid substring exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by two integers l and r (1 ≤ l < r ≤ n) representing the substring to reverse.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.split()[1:] and 1 <= int(stdout.split()[1]) < int(stdout.split()[2]) <= n)
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the indices l and r must satisfy 1 ≤ l < r ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (s_reversed := s[:int(l)-1] + s[int(r)-1:int(l)-1:-1] + s[int(r):]) < s
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed with indices l and r, reversing the substring s[l..r] must result in a lexicographically smaller string.
